features_title: Everything a small business keeps track of
features_body: One place for the books and for the work around them.
f_books_body: Every entry lands in a proper ledger, so profit and loss, balance sheet and cash flow are always ready.
f_invoices_body: Send invoices as PDF or email, record payments, and see who owes you and for how long.
f_vat_body: VAT on each line, and a monthly summary to fill in your Mushak 9.1 return.
f_statements_body: Import a statement and match each line to what you recorded, with rules for the repeats.
f_budgets_body: Set what you plan to spend and earn, and get a nudge before you go over.
f_tasks_body: Give work to your team, set due dates, and get reminded of bills and payments.
f_documents_body: Keep receipts and papers next to the money they belong to, and find them by searching.
f_ai_body: Ask about your business in Bangla or English and get answers with their source.

faq_1_q: Do I need a card to start?
faq_1_a: No. Sign up with your email and start using it. You only pay if you choose Pro.
faq_2_a: No. You pay for a month or a year at a time, and we remind you before it ends.
faq_3_a: Your account moves to Free after a few days of grace. Nothing is deleted. Businesses beyond the Free limit can still be read, and open again when you upgrade.
faq_4_q: Can my accountant or staff use it?
faq_4_a: Yes. Invite them by email and choose a role: owner, admin, accountant, manager or viewer.
faq_5_q: Can I take my data with me?
faq_5_a: Yes. Owners can download everything as one Excel file from the business settings, on any plan.
